title: No requirements.txt / pinned dependency file
evidence: run dir has no requirements.txt or pyproject.toml; Flask is only mentioned via `pip install flask` in README.md:54
suggestion: Add a requirements.txt pinning flask so the environment is reproducible

title: init_db() runs as an import side effect
evidence: app.py:166 calls init_db() at module load against the default DATABASE path, creating books.db on import
suggestion: Guard initialization behind __main__ or an app factory to avoid creating a DB file merely by importing the module

title: PUT with empty JSON body returns a misleading error
evidence: app.py:122-124 treats an empty object {} as falsy and returns 400 'Request body must be JSON' even though valid JSON was sent
suggestion: Distinguish 'no body' from 'empty object'; an empty PUT could be a no-op or a clearer validation error
